Run readiness (2026-09-18, GEN2_PREREG_AMENDMENT5): the candidate arm is a run output -- 'candidate_eval_report_path' is retired and a run must be given an evaluation seam that measures the artifact it selected -- and this declaration provides none of the six inputs run_campaign reads from disk as an existing artifact. Four have no parked file anywhere (project_template_path, training_material_path, data_registry_path, hardware_budget_path: the Gen-1 driver composed them in process), parent_profile_path has no Gen-1 measurement (the Gen-0 freeze profile is not the Gen-1 profile), the contamination manifest is produced by the run into its own state root, and the Gen-0 baseline arm is declared but not yet measured. Both 'chowder growth campaign plan' and '... run' therefore refuse before compute, naming every undeclared input at once. Amendment 6 (GEN2_PREREG_AMENDMENT6_2026-09-18) supplies the instrument that amendment 5 said was missing: the production candidate evaluator (chowder.growth.evaluation_binding.SubprocessEvaluationFn) now measures the selected adapter through the real transformers-text worker, and the run phase requires a seventh declared input, 'evaluation_material_path', naming the dataset and scoring for each declared benchmark. That file does not exist yet, so it joins the undeclared list below; the target instrument's diagnostic metadata (the judge's T1-T10) still lives only in the historical Gen-1 driver. That is the honest state of this declaration: no path is invented here to make it look runnable, and producing those documents from production code plus measuring the Gen-0 arm is the remaining pre-compute build (docs/HANDOFF.md, docs/ROADMAP.md).
